prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” agency for everyone — the right firm depends on your goals, budget, industry, and which channels you need (SEO, PPC, social, email, web design, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions first:

- What are your main goals? (e.g., more leads, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs)
- Which services do you need? (SEO, paid search/social, content, CRO, web development, omni‑channel)
- Monthly budget range (ballpark)?
- Timeline and any industry constraints (B2B, healthcare, franchise, local storefront)?
- Prefer local-only agencies or are remote teams OK?

How to evaluate St. Louis agencies (quick checklist)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (traffic, MQLs, ROAS)
- Client references and retention length
- Industry experience with your vertical or business model
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and tools they use
- Pricing model and contract flexibility (project vs. monthly retainer)
- Team size and who will actually do the work (not just an account manager)
- Certifications (Google Ads, HubSpot, Facebook Blueprint) as supporting evidence
- Trial project or short pilot before a long commitment

Where to find candidates
- Clutch.co, UpCity, and Google Maps (filter by location + reviews)
- Local lists: St. Louis Business Journal, Built In STL, or industry meetups
- LinkedIn searches and recommendations from peers in your network

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll:
- shortlist 4–6 St. Louis agencies that match your needs,
- include their strengths, typical clients, and what to ask them in an interview.
